name: replicon_landmarks
description: Plot support table (ADR-0043): oriC and terminus of every replicon, for V1 and V2 (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.3.5(e), §10.2). Not a result table.

fields.name: oric_position
fields.description: 1-based oriC position (giap.context.oriter.oric_position); NA on linear and no_oric replicons

fields.name: ter_position
fields.description: 1-based terminus position, ((oriC0 + L // 2) mod L) + 1; NA with oric_position

fields.name: status
fields.description: called, no_oric (no call or calls too far apart) or linear
